title: RealBud active core implementation worklist
definition: Original 61 acceptance contracts retained; S01-S04 add the user-requested managed-service/developer controls. Planned is not delivered. Historical handoff remains a dated snapshot.

status_contract.implemented: source complete but required acceptance missing
status_contract.verified: all listed acceptance has passing evidence at its required layer
status_contract.blocked: specific external condition prevents remaining criterion; independent work continues

tasks.outcome: Freeze the three workflow contracts and the new company/device target without changing the quoted customer agreement.
acceptance: Map all three outcomes and included assistance to source acquisition, permissions, reviewer, persistence and recovery checks.
Record host/client OS and architecture, people versus devices, source/account inventory, availability and capacity assumptions; real values remain pending where unknown.
verification: Master prompt copied and all61 original contracts retained; actual deployment/source worksheet remains open.
remaining_gates: Finish the workflow/source/reviewer crosswalk and deployment worksheet. Keep unknown customer people, accounts, formats and availability explicit; do not invent their approval.

tasks.outcome: Close the QM reuse choice within a two-engineer-day planning budget.
acceptance: Compare atomic grant and memory revision extraction with small local implementations; record dependency and migration owners.
Demonstrate concurrent revision rejection, revoke denial and duplicate claim behavior on synthetic data; retain notices if code is copied.
No QM runtime adoption, Docker install or source fork is a prerequisite; record no-reuse if dependencies outweigh benefit.

tasks.outcome: Select and prove automatically provisioned Postgres plus a confined stock-Hermes worker substrate on Windows and macOS.
acceptance: Exercise installation, restart, cancellation and preserved data after failed setup on clean Windows and Mac.
Native tools, terminal, execute_code and network attempts cannot read another context, host keys, database credentials or raw device endpoints.
Name the exact native/VM/container boundary, administrative requirements, resource cost and rollback; do not infer confinement from profiles.
If either host OS fails, mark that host unsupported pending a fix; no claim that the full requested cross-platform host target is complete.
verification: Disposable PostgreSQL16.15 fixture and host-secret environment denial passed; no OS confinement or native host installation proof.
remaining_gates: Prove the actual automatically provisioned host and worker confinement boundary on both supported OSs; existing PostgreSQL binaries, profiles and synthetic SQL tests do not establish this.

tasks.outcome: Define company, member, session, device, source, job, decision and scope identifiers and authorization contracts.
acceptance: A person may own two devices; device enrolment does not create a new member or grant source/admin rights.
Every shared record, command and result has an explicit owner/audience and revision.
verification: Company/member/scope/session identifiers implemented; device/job authority integration remains open.
Independent password sign-in and one-use member recovery preserve identity across sessions. Service-admin impersonation remains denied.
outputs/realbud-two-profile-testing-2026-09-14/README.md: compiled synthetic kit / native Mac database proof; remaining installed-device gates unchanged.

outputs/realbud-physical-macs-2026-09-14/README.md: physical MacBook/Mac mini synthetic setup, atomic credentials, encrypted join, private-scope denial, three dormant plans and restart/outage receipts; remaining full acceptance unchanged.
remaining_gates: Complete device, job, source and approval identity contracts beyond the current company/member/scope kernel; test multi-device identity separately from membership.

tasks.outcome: Introduce asynchronous repositories around current data owners without rewriting workflow algorithms.
acceptance: Existing domain behavior runs through repository interfaces; no hidden synchronous global access bypasses the scope boundary.
A storage failure remains a failure, not an empty store or sample fallback.
verification: Async company kernel only; existing domain repositories unchanged.
remaining_gates: Move existing JSON/SQLite domain access behind asynchronous scoped repositories. The new kernel has not migrated or replaced global Desk/Ask state.

tasks.outcome: Implement PostgreSQL storage, unique occurrence/action keys, scoped queries and transactional updates.
acceptance: Concurrent claims produce one active occurrence; conflicting revisions reject safely.
App database role cannot bypass scope policies; missing company/scope parameters fail.
Artifact metadata references protected blobs rather than copying credentials or entire source collections into records.
Actor/scope context is transaction-local and cleared between pooled requests, including scheduled service actors; interleaved-principal isolation passes.
verification: Restricted-role/RLS, transaction-local context, revision/revocation and fenced claims passed on real PG.
outputs/realbud-two-profile-testing-2026-09-14/README.md: compiled synthetic kit / native Mac database proof; remaining installed-device gates unchanged.

outputs/realbud-physical-macs-2026-09-14/README.md: physical MacBook/Mac mini synthetic setup, atomic credentials, encrypted join, private-scope denial, three dormant plans and restart/outage receipts; remaining full acceptance unchanged.
remaining_gates: Extend kernel proof to the actual service repository, artifact and occurrence contracts under restricted database roles and scheduled actors; complete upstream substrate gates.

tasks.outcome: Migrate current JSON/encrypted SQLite and artifact references through one verified cutover.
acceptance: Stopped writers, hash-verified complete backup, strict dry-run, retained IDs/corrections/sample labels and explicit unknown actors.

Before cutover, a fault leaves the original recoverable; after new-store activation/accepted writes, freeze and recover the latest authority rather than falling back to stale JSON/SQLite. One authority, invalidated legacy grants and no dual-write.
remaining_gates: Implement and fault-test the copy/dry-run/cutover migration, preserving existing office data and prohibiting stale fallback after new writes.

tasks.outcome: Extract company service lifecycle from Electron windows.
acceptance: Closing both clients keeps the service/clock alive; bounded crash restart reconciles persisted work.
Service runs with separate permissions from GUI companion; host reboot/unlock and failed startup have visible diagnostics.
verification: Owned PostgreSQL creation, clean stop/restart, cancellation preservation and GUI locale correction are locally tested.
remaining_gates: Implement native background-service ownership, startup and recovery separate from Electron windows and signed-in GUI companions.

tasks.outcome: Add the encrypted company entry point and named-member authentication.
acceptance: Existing per-boot loopback/admin endpoint remains private; clients never receive its boot token or database credentials.
Member roles and exact resource grants enforced on every operation; expiry/revocation invalidates active and queued work.
Use maintained auth/crypto libraries; rate-limit credential/pairing attempts; recovery does not bypass member authority.
verification: Actual pinned HTTPS joining between isolated local host/client controllers passes with shared/private scope checks and recovery.
outputs/realbud-two-profile-testing-2026-09-14/README.md: compiled synthetic kit / native Mac database proof; remaining installed-device gates unchanged.

outputs/realbud-physical-macs-2026-09-14/README.md: physical MacBook/Mac mini synthetic setup, atomic credentials, encrypted join, private-scope denial, three dormant plans and restart/outage receipts; remaining full acceptance unchanged.

Agency rehearsal: 481 company tests / 32 exact files, zero skips on native PostgreSQL; authenticated remote lifecycle/history/revocation routes are now exposed. Source evidence: outputs/realbud-agency-rehearsal-2026-09-14/README.md; new routes are not in the physical v2.1 kit.
remaining_gates: Native device identity/enrollment, intended-person verification, bounded pairing admission, full queued-work revocation, certificate renewal/host transfer, independent security review and installed Windows/macOS acceptance. Local TLS tests are not a two-machine office rollout.

tasks.outcome: Add expiring one-use invites, separate member sign-in and revocable device keys.
acceptance: Wrong-company, wrong-host, reused, expired and guessed invites fail; trust bootstrap verifies the host.
Device revocation closes dispatch access and invalidates grants; same member can add a second PC without duplicating schedules.
Invite binds company ID, host public key/certificate, intended authenticated member, nonce and expiry; discovery/link possession alone is insufficient. Verify host-key rotation and recovery.
verification: Invitation redemption/session persistence/revocation tested through real HTTP. Owner recovery refuses service-admin-only authority.
outputs/realbud-two-profile-testing-2026-09-14/README.md: compiled synthetic kit / native Mac database proof; remaining installed-device gates unchanged.

outputs/realbud-physical-macs-2026-09-14/README.md: physical MacBook/Mac mini synthetic setup, atomic credentials, encrypted join, private-scope denial, three dormant plans and restart/outage receipts; remaining full acceptance unchanged.

Six-profile real-PostgreSQL QA proves owner-only invitation cancellation and member offboarding, old-session/sign-in denial and recovery-required active claims. Device enrollment and audited recovery UI remain open.
remaining_gates: Add independently authenticated intended-member enrollment, verified host binding and device keys/revocation. Local invitation possession is not complete remote identity proof.

tasks.outcome: Scope conversations, queues, selections, events, artifacts, search and counters.
acceptance: Two concurrent private sessions never receive one another's content through API, websocket/event, file, search or logs.
A deliberately shared case works for both; wrong-ID access fails; active conversation selection belongs to the client/member.
Legacy conversation ownership is explicitly resolved before exposing migrated data.
verification: Private/shared company kernel scope only; global product surfaces remain local.

Six-profile department QA proves private-note and scope-inventory isolation, explicit department grants, read-only PM handovers, concurrent revision/history checks and restart persistence at the company kernel. Existing global product surfaces still need migration.

Explicit shared work now reaches a product Desk panel through current-member API/TLS authorization, reserved typed mutations and append-only revisions. No blanket conversation/Desk synchronization. Private notes, generic-case bypass, revocation and corruption failure paths have focused tests.
remaining_gates: Carry current member scope through all existing conversations, events, artifacts, search and counts; resolve legacy ownership before exposure.

tasks.outcome: Persist exact decisions, command attempts and event outbox transactionally.
acceptance: One-use approval binds payload/source/scope/device revisions and expiry; stale or differently scoped decisions fail.
Restart after an external effect but before receipt yields needs-checking; no blind replay or exactly-once external-effect claim.
remaining_gates: Wire exact decisions, commands and outbox to real execution, including crash-after-effect recovery; a case claim receipt is not an external-effect receipt.

tasks.outcome: Resolve server-owned member/office worker contexts on every launch.
acceptance: Ask, Prepare, manual and scheduled runs receive exact company/member/context/source authority.
No caller-controlled profile path; private native state persists under one exclusive home; no personal Hermes checkout changes.
remaining_gates: Resolve exact server-owned isolated worker contexts on every execution path; no caller profile/path authority.

tasks.outcome: Implement selected enforceable worker confinement and scoped input mounting.
acceptance: Direct native file/code/terminal/session-search attempts cannot reach other contexts, host admin data or unrestricted network/device tools.
Allowed sample files, stock memory/skills and explicitly mounted RealBud tools remain functional.
No copied browser cookies or broad host mounts; configured MCP/plugins/hooks remain suppressed by supported safe mode.
remaining_gates: Demonstrate real native file/code/terminal/network confinement while retaining stock memory, skills and allowed tools on both host OSs.

tasks.outcome: Centralize worker lifecycle, exclusive home ownership, fair queues and bounded capacity.
acceptance: Concurrent Ask/Prepare cannot start independent writers to the same Hermes home.
Restart resumes or holds exact runs; cancel waits for acknowledged execution stop before releasing ownership.
Measure idle memory, two-user latency and resource impact; queue overload instead of blocking staff's PC.
remaining_gates: Implement exclusive Hermes-home ownership, shared capacity queues and acknowledged-stop lifecycle; measure office load.

tasks.outcome: Bind each connection to exact owner/account/resources and operation grants.
acceptance: Verify OAuth account on completion and dispatch; prevent account substitution and scope expansion.
Revoke invalidates warm workers, queued jobs and decisions; shared source grant never exposes refresh tokens to workers.
remaining_gates: Finish account-specific grants and enforce them across queued/warm work, OAuth completion, revocation and every dispatch.

tasks.outcome: Use one execution service for Ask, Run now, routines and future delegated jobs.
acceptance: All paths use the same source, artifact, approval, budget and result-verification boundary.
A model answer alone cannot mark an external result saved or financial work completed.
remaining_gates: Route Ask, Prepare, Run now and the company clock through one scoped execution/verification boundary.

tasks.outcome: Create an outbound authenticated companion channel with device/session capability reporting.
acceptance: Only enrolled keys connect; signed-in session, OS/architecture/version, control readiness and heartbeat are explicit.
Helper endpoints stay local; locked/logged-out/offline state cannot report ready.
remaining_gates: Implement enrolled outbound companion identity and live GUI readiness without exposing raw helper endpoints.

tasks.outcome: Enforce durable per-device GUI leases and action envelopes at actual dispatch.
acceptance: Check company/actor/job/run/source/account/device/session/epoch/generation/target/payload/expiry before every native operation.
Reject repeated command IDs, wrong devices, expired/revoked grants and competing controllers; never treat timeout as old-controller death.
Companion persists accepted intent before native execution and terminal/unknown outcomes after it; restart consults the protected journal before any repeated command.
remaining_gates: Implement durable device-command journals, per-device leases and exact-envelope validation at native dispatch.

tasks.outcome: Make local Stop, takeover, disconnect and resume observable and safe.
acceptance: Local Stop prevents further actions immediately; host Stop remains pending until acknowledged; asynchronous taskkill completion is observed.
Lost connection prevents new actions, uncertain in-flight effects require reconciliation, and the next lease waits for stop proof.
Login/MFA occurs under human control; resume checks same account, app, session and current grant.
remaining_gates: Prove local/remote Stop, process settlement and uncertain-effect recovery before releasing or reacquiring device ownership.

tasks.outcome: Replace raw ACP Cua mounting and bind every computer path to the RealBud broker.
acceptance: Ask, Prepare and schedules cannot reach raw Cua/native transport outside the job fence.
Native/code attempts to call helper endpoints directly fail; per-instance Submit cannot authorize pay/sign/notice/send.
remaining_gates: Remove all usable raw Cua/native bypasses and apply the exact saved job fence to every computer-use route.

tasks.outcome: Support device-bound file reads and authorized artifact staging/read-back.
acceptance: A path on PC A never resolves against PC B; approved copies preserve origin, hash, actor and audience.
Download/preview and upload routes enforce membership; changing input invalidates prepared output approval.
remaining_gates: Bind input/output files and verified transfers to the intended device, member and artifact digest.

tasks.outcome: Verify native Windows app/browser execution through the enrolled companion.
acceptance: Exercise supported Windows 11 hardware, target window/account, foreground changes, Excel/file workflow, UAC/lock/logout, Stop and recovery.
Preserve exact installer/runtime/driver evidence; CI on Windows Server is not Windows 11 acceptance.
remaining_gates: Run real installed Windows 11 native-app/browser/Excel/lock/UAC/Stop recovery acceptance with the admitted driver.

tasks.outcome: Verify native macOS app/browser execution through the enrolled companion.
acceptance: Exercise Accessibility/Screen Recording permission grant/denial/repair, correct app/session, lock/logout, Stop and recovery.
Use supported hardware and final identity/signing; Mac success does not satisfy Windows cells.
remaining_gates: Run real installed Mac permission/app/session/lock/Stop recovery acceptance with final signing identity.

tasks.outcome: Demonstrate two clients, private conversations, one shared bill case and one stoppable Windows read.
acceptance: One company/clock/store; two members cannot read private markers; shared job visible to both permitted people.
Correct enrolled PC supplies harmless source, isolated Hermes prepares answer, result persists and reloads with verified receipt.
Wrong-device, revoked grant, disconnect, duplicate request and unknown-outcome paths produce expected holds.
remaining_gates: Demonstrate the complete two-person slice with isolated stock Hermes and an enrolled stoppable Windows read; two local browser sessions or SQL claims do not satisfy it.

tasks.outcome: Complete reusable pack installation including dependencies, schemas, scripts and private bindings.
acceptance: Clean office installs everything required for three outcomes without manual support-file copying.
Private settings/accounts/samples/live state are distinct; pack export excludes credentials/customer data; update retains bindings/corrections.
Sample acceptance and exact live cadence activation remain separate.

Use a capability registry and validated versioned manifest for operator-described or demonstrated new workflow proposals; unsupported operations cannot be activated before adapter/verifier acceptance.
remaining_gates: Install all required files, schemas, scripts, bindings and validated capabilities for the three outcomes on a clean office.

tasks.outcome: Build complete approved mail/calendar acquisition for morning priorities.
acceptance: Persist per-member filters, source coverage/cursors and freshness; retain urgent work and incomplete-source warnings.
No mailbox mutation; retries/pagination do not omit or duplicate threads; private accounts remain isolated.
remaining_gates: Deliver complete authorized inbox/calendar acquisition and current source coverage, including disconnected/partial-source states.

tasks.outcome: Connect inbox to invoice evidence and continuing bill cases.
acceptance: Accepted invoice evidence updates the durable case through typed validators, not by trusting model prose.
Deduplicate attachment/invoice/source observations; retain corrections and unresolved work across days; reports link original sources.
remaining_gates: Connect actual acquisition to validated invoice evidence and one continuing case, preserving corrections and original sources.

tasks.outcome: Complete expected/missing-bill follow-through with current source evidence.
acceptance: Staff confirms expectations; received/processed/funded/arranged/paid remain separate; stale/ambiguous evidence holds.
Two authorized members see one shared case with owner/reviewer; independent payment evidence required for paid status.
remaining_gates: Deliver recurring expected/missing-bill follow-through across days and members with distinct received/processed/paid evidence.

tasks.outcome: Acquire the agreed ANZ export through an authorized session/source.
acceptance: Human login/MFA and exact account/format verification; original preserved and hashed before processing.
Automatic acquisition must pass actual-device acceptance; manual-upload fallback labelled and cannot pass this gate.
remaining_gates: Obtain and verify an authorized real ANZ export/schema on the intended enrolled device; synthetic or manual-upload fallback is separately labelled.

tasks.outcome: Produce human-reviewed reference corrections and a verified REI-checkable copy.
acceptance: Every change reviewed against current batch/original digest; ambiguous candidates held.
Dates, amounts, row count, row order and all untouched fields match original; saved copy read-back verified.
Staff confirms actual REI preview/recognition; no autonomous financial import, payment or money movement.
remaining_gates: Prove exact financial-field preservation, human-reviewed output digest and actual authorized REI preview acceptance; final posting/receipting/payment remain human/external.

tasks.outcome: Implement scoped Calendar preparation and exact-approved internal entries.
acceptance: No attendees/invitations/outgoing notifications; current item revision and explicit one-use approval required for edits.
Persist and read back exact saved result; uncertainty reconciled without duplicate entries.
remaining_gates: Implement approved Calendar entries with exact read-back and no invitations, attendees or outgoing notifications.

tasks.outcome: Deliver scoped file lookup, five templates, new draft copies and summaries.
acceptance: Read only approved source tree; write new copies only to accepted output folder; no overwrite/move/delete/permission change.
Five agreed templates plus on-demand/weekly summary render from granted sources; verify saved outputs and duplicate protection.
remaining_gates: Deliver authorized file lookup, five agreed templates, new draft copies and source-linked summaries with result verification.

tasks.outcome: Enable one company clock with per-member briefs and shared-source occurrence dedupe.
acceptance: Concurrent manual/scheduled requests produce one shared occurrence; missed-run catch-up is bounded and honest.
Ready-by accounts for measured collection/runtime budget, timezone/DST, source lateness and host outage; no hidden second clock.
No automatic live activation; readiness and current source approval required.
remaining_gates: Connect all completed workflows to the single durable clock; test timezone, lateness, occurrence dedupe and bounded catch-up before live activation.

tasks.outcome: Bind the selected phone continuation route to authenticated member and exact job.
acceptance: Private reply/decision route cannot disclose another member's task; stale or reused approvals fail.
Phone Stop shows acknowledged/unreachable state; uncertain send receipt is inspected before retry; no tenant route.
remaining_gates: Implement authenticated real-phone delivery/continuation/Stop tied to the current job, and verify it separately from browser simulations.

tasks.outcome: Add private, team/case and company knowledge with grants and provenance.
acceptance: Read/search/edit/revoke share use current scope; entries have author/source/freshness/version/correction links.
Concurrent edits reject stale revisions; outdated memory cannot override authoritative source or workflow evaluator.
Revoke ends affected warm sessions and invalidates derived caches/indexes/procedure versions; retained historical evidence has explicit audience/retention.
remaining_gates: Extend scoped kernel knowledge to actual source-backed read/search/edit/revocation, derived-index purge and historical retention.

tasks.outcome: Implement bounded typed helper subtasks on shared cases.
acceptance: Effective rights intersect job/delegation/recipient grants; no borrowing credentials or approval power.
Parent/child lineage, output schema, depth/budget/deadline and dedupe enforced; cycles/cancel/partial failure reconcile.
Start with one helper per parent; no uncontrolled agent chatter or roster UI.
remaining_gates: Implement one bounded helper per parent with intersected rights, typed output, lineage, budget, dedupe and cancellation.

tasks.outcome: Promote learned procedures through reviewed versions and replay.
acceptance: Private candidate sanitized, replayed on representative cases, approved by owner, published by version and rollback tested.
Learned content cannot expand tools, source grants, budgets, schedules or locked actions; measure actual benefit.
Do not persist revocable shared content into private native memory until provenance-based purge/rebuild is proven; ephemeral job contexts and broker references are the initial safe route.
remaining_gates: Implement reviewed/sanitized learning promotion, representative replay, version rollback and revocable-source purge before native persistence.

tasks.outcome: Build resumable Set up a company using the existing visual system.
acceptance: No terminal/database/container instructions in supported flow; dependencies and human OS/account steps clearly separated.
Restart/resume does not duplicate company/database; three sample outcomes and recovery setup have persisted completion receipts.
Render/inspect supported desktop window sizes and keyboard accessibility.
verification: Source UI can prepare an admitted installed PostgreSQL runtime and create a company; clean installer/binary delivery and resumable recovery remain open.

tasks.outcome: Expose People, Devices, Sources and Recovery under You with progressive disclosure.
acceptance: Owner can inspect/revoke device/member/source grants and see consequences; normal staff have only granted controls.
Set up/Join/Move/Restore workflows preserve four-place product navigation; implementation settings remain Advanced.
remaining_gates: Deliver usable member/device/source/recovery administration and owner/member distinctions within existing You navigation.

tasks.outcome: Produce consistent encrypted backups of database, artifacts, keys and worker state.
acceptance: Backup captures coherent work/knowledge/pack/runtime metadata and recoverable keys; failure cannot report success.
Restore on another machine validates referential integrity, hashes, private scope and unresolved state; no live data-dir copying.
Measure agreed recovery targets and off-device backup age.
remaining_gates: Implement and actually restore a coherent protected backup of PostgreSQL, artifacts, private state and recoverable keys.

tasks.outcome: Move or recover the host with old-authority fencing and safe re-enrollment.
acceptance: Planned move stops/fences old host; disaster path rotates trust, re-enrolls and pauses activation until old controllable paths are excluded.
No automatic failover; epoch alone is not split-brain prevention; stale devices/commands cannot resume.
One company, preserved identities, no duplicate occurrences; uncertain effects held.
remaining_gates: Prove host move/disaster recovery with old-authority fencing, re-enrollment and no split-host duplicate execution.

tasks.outcome: Measure and cap ordinary-PC load, model usage and helper cost.
acceptance: Two active members plus normal staff work fit declared resource budget; fair queued overload and disk-pressure holds.
Cost attributed once to parent/child/member; approved provider identity and refresh ownership preserved.
Record baseline and scaling limit; no unlimited-desktop or speed claim without measured evidence.
remaining_gates: Measure ordinary-PC capacity, fair queuing, latency, disk pressure and attributed provider/helper cost; avoid unmeasured speed or scale claims.

tasks.outcome: Package and sign the complete Windows host/client/companion distribution.
acceptance: Build exact reviewed source including intended dirty changes; record revision/digests.
Clean Windows 11 install, service/session separation, permissions, upgrade rollback and preserved user state pass.
No customer deployment or publication until separate authorized release gate.
remaining_gates: Build from an immutable reviewed snapshot, sign and test installed Windows host/client/companion upgrade and rollback.

tasks.outcome: Package and sign/notarize the complete macOS host/client/companion distribution.
acceptance: Exact reviewed artifact; clean supported Mac install, permissions after update, system/GUI-service separation and rollback pass.
Verify supported CPU architecture and host restart/unlock behavior; no speculative automatic-login requirement.
remaining_gates: Build from an immutable reviewed snapshot, sign/notarize and test installed Mac host/client/companion upgrade and rollback.

acceptance: All three workflows available to each authorized member from Windows and macOS clients, routing native steps to a compatible enrolled execution device; all four host/client OS pairs. Prove both native adapters with representative supported apps; Windows-only apps remain on Windows.
Wrong-ID, leaked events, raw MCP bypass, stale decision, duplicate job, unknown external effect, host partition and malicious skill cases.
Record actual failures and fixes against final artifacts; do not collapse test/build/install/live proof.
Verify native Composio lifecycle/identity/batch denials, Cua version/permission contracts, exact browser target/session persistence, secret-safe website-to-CLI and dependency retirement on both OSs.

Verify final signed Windows/Mac update, crash reconciliation, withdrawn candidate/rollback holds, offline eligibility and preservation of current company data/native learning against the accepted maintenance policy.

tasks.outcome: Complete named-office live acceptance, training and operating handover for agreed expanded scope.
acceptance: Before live access, confirm named source/device/reviewer rights and any required scope variation; prepare all independent work first.
Observe accepted schedules and all three outcomes with source/result evidence, correction rate, latency and staff review time.
Deliver configured pack, five templates, account/permission register, backup/restore guide, two training sessions or newly agreed equivalent and agreed observation/check-ins.
No signoff from synthetic-only or manual bank-upload-only evidence.

tasks.outcome: Define native Composio, Cua, browser, CLI and utility contracts with a versioned platform capability matrix.
acceptance: Each operation names source/account requirements, route, exact version/schema, supported OS/architecture, action policy, cancellation, verifier and lifecycle status.
Separate current 0.19.3 MCP support from newer Cua candidate and Hermes native-wrapper requirements; no discovered capability is executable by default.
remaining_gates: Freeze the operation-by-operation platform/version/permission/cancellation/verifier matrix; discovery is not admission.

tasks.outcome: Implement the native host Composio adapter and stable company/member/account ownership.
acceptance: Use a pinned official SDK or maintained typed REST; no model-provider replacement. Exact provider/account/auth-config/toolkit versions validated.
Choose isolated office-owned project credentials or a managed platform connection broker; never distribute one shared platform key to customer hosts, renderers or workers.
Record supported credential provisioning; no invented automatic provider API or default first/latest-account selection.

Installed RealBud now passes exact-approved live Gmail label-list and alternate-account Calendar-list calls with durable receipts. Source fixes pin existing Composio ownership across key rotation/clear/reconnect and preserve profile identity in access checks; 162 affected tests and typecheck pass. No per-member host adapter or packaged source-fix claim.
remaining_gates: Complete the native Composio adapter, exact account ownership and trusted credential-provisioning choice; broad existing connection badges are not completion.

tasks.outcome: Build account-specific native Connect, Complete, Check, Reconnect, Disable and Revoke without an idle Ask dependency.
acceptance: Durable actor-bound link intent, exact connection ID, nonce/expiry and independently verified provider principal; forwarded/wrong/duplicate links cannot bind arbitrary accounts.
Ordinary polling stays LAN-compatible; optional public verifier uses a narrow managed relay when required, not an exposed office API.
